notes.title: Grimwalker Release Postponed to Q4 2025
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

I would like to inform you that due to ongoing work on Grimwalker, the release has been postponed to Q4 2025. I apologize for this change and any inconvenience it may cause. I want to assure you that I am doing everything possible to deliver a product that meets your expectations.

I will share more information and updates on the progress of the game soon.

Thank you for your patience and support.
GrimArctic
